prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the warm low sun in glowing glints, the golden light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
